chunks: Say: "Had there been other gods with Him, as they assert, they would surely have sought a way (of opposition) against the Lord of the Throne."
ai.seo_question: What is the argument against polytheism in Surah Al-Isra verse 42?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a logical proof against the coexistence of multiple deities, suggesting that if they shared authority, they would compete for dominance over the Throne, leading to chaos. It underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty (Al-Hakimiyyah) and serves as a refutation of polytheistic beliefs by highlighting the singular, unrivaled nature of Divine Will.
